rule: Manual/locked exercises always outrank AI suggestions. AI fills gaps rather than rebuilding the user's frame.
AI may add multiple exercises targeting the same muscle when the workout goal and volume allow it.
Intentional duplicate exercise instances are allowed and must have unique plan_item_id values.
AI should warn about likely redundant exercise-family overlap but should not prohibit it.
During an active session, substitutions must preserve completed-set history for the original exercise.
AI must use current gym/setup equipment profile before proposing an exercise.
AI should use prior performance as context, not overwrite logged history or silently change planned targets.
When live conditions change (machine busy, discomfort, time shortage), AI can re-rank only unfinished work.
The UI order is user-editable at any time; workout sequence is a queue, not a forced wizard.
Post-session progression suggestions should be proposals requiring app rules/user acceptance, not direct history edits.
